verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships a built-in `crewai test` CLI command that runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports detailed performance metrics. The observability docs also mention evaluating agents. As a CLI command it could plausibly run in a pipeline, but nothing documents CI integration or what the scores measure. missing for 10: documented CI integration (exit codes, pass/fail thresholds, pipeline examples), detail on the evaluation criteria and scoring of agent quality, independent or hands-on corroboration.
